description: Answer both 'how bad did it get' and 'is it really diversified' for a built-in model portfolio or canonical strategy. Drawdowns: the deepest peak-to-trough episodes with months to trough and recovery, Ulcer index, longest time underwater, monthly VaR/CVaR 95, worst month and year, and returns in 2008, 2020 and 2022. Diversification: each holding's share of the risk next to its share of the money (60/40 is about 60% of the money and 93% of the risk), the number of independent bets over the full window, the last 10 years and the 36 months to Feb 2009 and Dec 2022, co-movement groups, near-duplicate pairs and the equal-risk weights. Correlations: the holdings' correlation matrix. Pass exactly one of `template` (e.g. classic-60-40, all-weather) or `strategy` (e.g. faber-trend-timing); list_portfolios shows valid ids. `sections` limits the output. Read-only, precomputed from the monthly refresh (data through the stated month), instant. For headline CAGR/Sharpe use analyze_portfolio; for calendar returns use portfolio_returns; for custom allocations use analyze_portfolio.

episodes.description: How many of the deepest drawdown episodes to list (1-8). Default 5.

sections.description: Which parts to return: drawdowns, diversification, correlations. Default: all three.

strategy.description: Canonical rule-based strategy id, e.g. 'faber-trend-timing'. A strategy is one rule-based line, so its diversification section is reported as not applicable.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio id, e.g. 'classic-60-40', 'all-weather', 'golden-butterfly'. list_portfolios shows all 19.

name: portfolio_risk
